rationale: The lines selecting this family rename the render layer's CAMetalLayer-backed GPU surface NSView in core/render/src/metal_surface_mac.mm from PulpMetalView to PulpMetalSurfaceView, the distinct base name its per-binary names header (pulp_render_objc_names.h) already mapped it to, so the render and view ObjC clusters can be compiled into one per-binary translation unit without the two clusters' PulpMetalView renames shadowing each other. The class's behavior, the Metal surface, the renderer, every asset path and the per-binary suffix are unchanged; the co-load probe registered as mac-objc-coload-PulpGain-PulpEffect requires PulpMetalSurfaceView to exist under both binaries' suffixes and never bare. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes; the transferred rendering slice remains under watch.
